🎬 Dracula (2025)

Dracula follows Prince Vladimir, a powerful 15th-century ruler whose life is shattered when his beloved wife, Elisabeta, is tragically killed. Overwhelmed by grief and anger, Vladimir turns against God and becomes cursed with immortality, transforming into the legendary vampire Dracula. For centuries, he wanders through the world, haunted by memories of his lost love and desperately searching for a way to reunite with her. When he encounters a young woman who bears an extraordinary resemblance to Elisabeta, his obsession reignites, setting the stage for a dark and passionate story filled with supernatural danger, forbidden romance, and haunting secrets. Starring Caleb Landry Jones, Christoph Waltz, and Zoë Bleu, the film combines Gothic horror, breathtaking historical settings, and emotional storytelling while exploring eternal love, loss, obsession, faith, and the devastating consequences of immortality.

🎭 Genre: Gothic Horror • Fantasy • Romance • Drama

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 9m • R

🎥 Director: Luc Besson

✍️ Writer: Luc Besson

📚 Based On: Bram Stoker’s classic 1897 novel Dracula.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Dracula (or Dracula: A Love Tale in select countries) is a 2025 English-language French Gothic romantic fantasy film, written and directed by Luc Besson, based on the 1897 novel Dracula by Bram Stoker. It stars Caleb Landry Jones as Dracula, alongside Christoph Waltz and Zoë Bleu. It was theatrically released in France on 30 July 2025, by SND and had a wide theatrical release in North America on 6 February 2026. The film received mixed critical reviews and positive reviews from audiences, and has currently grossed $42.5 million worldwide on a budget of $52 million. The film received financial support from the CNC.
